data: What is the approximate value of the green line at x- axis value of 5 in the top left graph?

The green line represents the values for the Simon model with varying W0. To find the approximate value of the green line at the x-axis value of 5, we need to look at the top left graph labeled "Two Captains". At x=5, the green line appears to be around 400 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the green line at x-axis value of 5 is 400.
